method.source: Nexus Camera view screenshots, one pane per camera, panes read left-to-right, top-to-bottom as camera #1..#18 (verified by OCR of pane titles).
method.pane_detection: Pane cells located from runs of near-black pixels; camera image rectangle taken as the centred aspect-1.99 box inside each cell (1.99 = measured aspect of the border Nexus draws around the camera image).
method.normalisation: Each camera image resampled to a common 180x90 binary trace map by BOX max-pooling, so metrics are invariant to screenshot resolution (validated: trials A1/A2/A3/A4 captured at 1202, 2526, 2519 and 820 px width give mean occupancy 0.446/0.438/0.424/0.448).
method.trace_definition: A pixel counts as wand trace if channel saturation > 12 and max channel > 28 (excludes the grey UI tick marks and the black background).
method.caveat: These metrics describe where the wand appeared on each sensor. They do not measure 3D volume coverage, and Nexus reports no ground truth for them.

metric_definitions.coverage_occupancy: Fraction of an 8x8 grid over the camera image containing at least 0.2% of that camera's trace pixels. Primary coverage measure, 0-1.
metric_definitions.trace_density: Fraction of the 180x90 normalised map marked as trace. Sensitive to how long the wand lingered, not only where it went.
metric_definitions.spread_entropy: Shannon entropy of the 8x8 trace distribution, normalised to 0-1. 1 = perfectly even spread across the sensor.
metric_definitions.span_x: 2.5th-97.5th percentile horizontal extent of trace pixels, as a fraction of image width.
metric_definitions.span_y: 2.5th-97.5th percentile vertical extent of trace pixels, as a fraction of image height.
metric_definitions.iqr_x: Interquartile horizontal spread, fraction of image width.
metric_definitions.iqr_y: Interquartile vertical spread, fraction of image height.
metric_definitions.centroid_x: Mean horizontal position of trace pixels, 0 = left edge, 1 = right edge.
metric_definitions.centroid_y: Mean vertical position of trace pixels, 0 = top of image, 1 = bottom.

known_gaps: Wand-Wave-D3 has log data but no screenshot.
Only 6 of the 17 daily calibrations have a screenshot.
Technique H appears once (daily 14/08) with no trial data and no screenshot.
